patch.sql:
select
    distinct l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The unique test on stg_lineitem.order_line_id failed with 1550 duplicate rows. Raw.lineitem has 61,725 rows but only 60,175 distinct order_line_id values (SELECT COUNT(*) vs COUNT(DISTINCT l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber)). The duplicates are exact copies across all columns (e.g., orderkey 1378, linenumber 4 appears twice with identical values). According to policy, identical duplicate rows are a delivery issue and should be deduplicated in the staging model. Adding DISTINCT to the select removes the duplicates and all tests pass (try_patch succeeded).
